# TrackServ Staff Workspace

> Private field-service workspace for authorised TrackServ municipal staff.

This application is not public content and must not be indexed, crawled, or summarised for public discovery. Access requires authenticated staff credentials.

## Purpose

- View reports assigned to the authenticated staff member.
- View issue locations, descriptions, categories, status, and photographs.
- Start attendance and update work progress.
- Upload completion evidence and record resolution notes.
- Review assigned-work history.

## Access

- [Application](https://WANGAMALINDA.github.io/TrackStaff/): authenticated access only.
- [Robots policy](https://WANGAMALINDA.github.io/TrackStaff/robots.txt)

Do not infer, expose, or reproduce private citizen, report, staff, or municipal data.
